mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM t_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND pay_time >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM t_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_order WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM t_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY d

SELECT oi.spu_name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty, SUM(oi.total_amount) AS amount FROM t_order_item oi INNER JOIN t_order o ON o.order_no = oi.order_no AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE o.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY oi.sku_id, oi.spu_name ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 5
